conditions: Free 'Basic' listing exists but sits on a waiting list reported at roughly 1–3 months due to demand
Paid tiers bypass the wait: Premium $199/year lists within 24 hours with homepage feature and newsletter inclusion; Platinum $999/year adds ~3 months site-wide sponsorship
A site account (Login link present) is likely required for the JS submit app
requirements: Product must be an AI tool/company
Submission goes through the JS app at https://aidepot.co/submit/start — fields are not publicly visible
Third-party coverage describes a two-track model: free-with-waitlist vs paid fast lanes
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, logo and category
An account on aidepot.co if the submit app requires login
Decision on free waitlist vs Premium ($199/yr) or Platinum ($999/yr)
workflow: Open https://aidepot.co/submit/start in a JS-capable browser
Complete the multi-step submission (plan choice → tool details)
Free: join the waiting list; paid: checkout and expect listing within ~24 hours
Verify the tool appears on aidepot.co with its own profile page and outbound link
watchFor: The submit app is entirely client-side rendered — no public view of the form fields
Free listings may wait months; do not promise a date on the free tier
Paid tiers are annual fees ($199/$999 per year), not one-time
The site also sells directory-submission services and data lists — expect upsell prompts
Pricing comes from third-party coverage; confirm live prices inside the submit flow before paying
